evals.prompt: /tmux-handoff I want to refactor the auth module from master — it's getting too big and needs splitting into separate files for login, session, and token management
evals.expected_output: Skill creates a worktree from master with a slugified branch name, opens a vertical pane split, writes a focused handoff doc covering the auth refactor goal, and launches claude with that doc. No files moved.
expectations: git worktree add was run with master or main as the target ref
branch name is a slug derived from the prompt (e.g. contains 'auth' and 'refactor')
worktree path contains .claude/worktrees/
a handoff document was written (non-empty)
handoff document mentions the auth module refactor goal
handoff document is focused — under 40 lines with no irrelevant context
tmux pane split command was generated (split-window), not a new window
claude launch command references the handoff document content

evals.prompt: /tmux-handoff move src/utils/legacy_parser.py to a new window — I realized this fix belongs on main not on my feature branch
evals.expected_output: Skill creates a worktree from current HEAD, opens a new tmux window, copies legacy_parser.py to the destination worktree, resets/deletes it from source, writes a focused handoff doc, and launches claude.
expectations: tmux new-window command was generated (not split-window)
src/utils/legacy_parser.py was copied to the destination worktree
src/utils/legacy_parser.py was reset or deleted in the source worktree
worktree path contains .claude/worktrees/
git worktree add was run without a specific target ref (defaults to HEAD)
a handoff document was written and references the parser file
claude launch command references the handoff document

evals.prompt: /tmux-handoff feat/hotfix-rate-limiting — there's a rate limiting bug in production, move the patch from api/middleware/rate_limit.py, branch from main
evals.expected_output: Skill uses the explicit branch name 'feat/hotfix-rate-limiting', creates worktree from main, moves rate_limit.py (FIX version to destination, BUG version restored in source), opens default pane split, writes focused handoff doc about the rate limiting hotfix.
expectations: branch name is exactly feat/hotfix-rate-limiting
git worktree add was run with main as the target ref
destination file contains the FIX version (references 'requests_this_minute' or 'reset')
source file contains the BUG version (references 'counter never resets' or just returns True)
tmux pane split command generated (split-window), not a new window
handoff document mentions rate limiting, production bug, and that the fix is uncommitted
